feature.adapter_commit: 63a3ea9 feat: resolve latest user-reported personal-best time
feature.scope: Current personal-best-time questions with an exact user-authored time for the same event and a unique observation date.
safety_conditions: Conflicting values on the latest observation date are unresolved.
Observations after the question date are ignored.
The rewritten answer must pass the existing citation validator.

frozen_replays.question: What was my personal best time in the charity 5K run?

decision: Keep the resolver opt-in. It corrected one saved answer using a later exact user-authored personal-best statement, passed the judge and answer validator, and did not change any other saved answer in either replay.
limitations: This is a deterministic postprocessor replay over two saved 500-answer runs, not fresh answer generation. Stage243 remains the best fresh full Top-20 result at 438/500 (87.6%). The 97% accuracy target and 100% memory precision target remain unmet.
